strategies.name: Detection Strategy for Overwritten Process Arguments Masquerading

analytics.name: Analytic 0466
analytics.guidance: Detects adversary behavior where the command-line arguments of a running process are overwritten in memory to spoof the process name, typically replacing it with a benign or misleading string. The detection correlates unexpected null byte sequences, discrepancies between `/proc//cmdline` and process ancestry, and suspicious memory writes shortly after process start.

tuning.description: Time threshold after process creation during which argv memory manipulation is expected to be rare; anomalies occurring outside this window may be more suspicious.
List of known legitimate processes where argv[0] mismatch is expected due to application logic or packaging quirks.
Trusted parent binaries allowed to spawn processes with altered command-line names.
